title: Module 3 — Daily routine, time, food and leisure
description: Tell the time, describe a daily routine, order food and drinks, and accept or decline invitations, using -ir verbs, reflexive verbs and the everyday irregular verbs (ir, ver, ler, sair, ouvir).

topics.title: Time, days, months and dates
topics.brief: Telling the time (São três horas, É meio-dia, e um quarto, e meia, menos um quarto); parts of the day (de manhã, à tarde, à noite); days of the week, months and dates (Hoje é dia … de …).

topics.title: Daily routine and habits
topics.brief: Presente do Indicativo of regular -ir verbs (vestir, abrir, decidir, partir); reflexive verbs in the present (levantar-se, deitar-se, vestir-se, lavar-se); irregular verbs ir, ver, ler, sair, ouvir; habitual actions with costumar + infinitivo.
topics.known: Module 1 and 2 grammar (ar/er verbs, pronouns); m3-time-dates.
topics.avoid: past tenses, subjunctive, object pronouns other than reflexive se.

topics.title: Food, drinks and eating out
topics.brief: Food, drinks and dishes vocabulary; reading a menu and ordering at a restaurant or café; polite requests with Queria… (Queria um café, Queria a conta, por favor).

topics.title: Leisure and invitations
topics.brief: Talking about free time and leisure activities; accepting an invitation (Sim, com certeza! Adoraria.) and declining politely (Não posso, tenho de…; Talvez noutro dia.).
topics.known: Module 1 and 2 grammar; m3-daily-routine (gostar de + infinitivo).

topics.title: Prepositions of time and frequency
topics.brief: Prepositions of time a, de, em (às três horas, de manhã, em janeiro); frequency adverbs (sempre, nunca, às vezes, habitualmente, geralmente); expressing frequency with por (por dia, por semana, três vezes por mês).
